prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop homepage comp for fcullmann.com, approximately 1440 × 1000 landscape
Primary request: Design a contemporary, bespoke portfolio-and-tools homepage for Florian Ullmann. It must unmistakably read as a real working website screen, not a poster. The focal experience is live tool feedback: a useful JSON formatter is integrated directly into the introductory canvas.
Scene/backdrop: One continuous edge-to-edge editorial sheet inspired by open-source release notes, changelog ledgers, and printed software manuals. Use dense but controlled rules, registration marks, issue stamps, line numbering, tiny functional metadata, and disciplined grid alignment. Do not turn sections into a rounded card mosaic.
Subject: A compact horizontal navigation at the top. In the first viewport, a monumental but precise introduction reading “Florian Ullmann” and “Senior Software Engineer” shares the canvas with a real JSON formatter specimen. Show a clearly editable JSON input with plausible syntax, an obvious “Format JSON” action, and a crisp formatted output/result state with syntax color, indentation, line numbers, validation success, and copy affordance. The beginning of a ranked “Featured tools” ledger must visibly cross the fold, led by “01 JSON Formatter”, followed by “02 Base64” and “03 UUID Generator”. Lower-page glimpses should hint at selected projects and a “Latest writing” section.
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity desktop web UI screenshot; Swiss editorial precision with the tactility of an uncoated technical manual; senior software engineer sensibility; information-dense but calm; subtle imperfections only in paper grain and stamped utility marks.
Composition/framing: full-page straight-on desktop website at a 1440 × 1000-ish ratio, no browser chrome or device frame. Compact header, then one continuous first-viewport composition with a single unapologetic typography scale jump for the name. Preserve clear interactive hierarchy and realistic web spacing. Let the Featured tools ledger begin near the lower edge so it is visibly crossing the fold.
Lighting/mood: flat screen-native presentation, confident, exacting, useful, editorial rather than cinematic.
Color palette: uncoated technical paper #F2F0E9; deep ink #17211D; cobalt #3155D9; acid chartreuse #C7F36B. Use color sparingly for active controls, syntax, status, ranking, and registration details.
Materials/textures: restrained uncoated paper grain, crisp ink, fine editorial rules; all interface controls remain sharp and screen-legible.
Text (verbatim): “Florian Ullmann”; “Senior Software Engineer”; “Tools that earn their tab.”; “Format JSON”; “Featured tools”; “JSON Formatter”; “Base64”; “UUID Generator”; “Latest writing”.
Constraints: English language. Render the required text exactly and legibly. Make the JSON formatter look genuinely usable and already responding live. Include compact navigation labels and an understated fcullmann.com wordmark. One continuous editorial sheet, strong grid, precise alignment, accessible contrast, believable responsive desktop UI, clear links and controls.
Avoid: Bootstrap cards, generic SaaS dashboard styling, generic gradients, rounded card mosaics, portrait photography, fake metrics, illegible decorative text, ornamental gibberish, excessive tiny text, device frames, browser chrome, watermark, poster-only composition, huge empty hero with no working UI.
